boundary.resolution: Installed-resource and inter-unit-route orientation: program execution, map/reservations, DMA, IRQ/SYSTEM/INPUT/IMGDEC, shared graphics/display, GTE/GEO and APU. Detailed unit contracts remain canonical; this is not whole-manual completion.

registers.resolution: Overview gives word meanings and resource counts, not a duplicate register catalog. Explicit links lead to the CPU/Memory and owning unit references for addresses, fields, access and reset words. Private APU source base is expressly not a CPU aperture.

datapath.resolution: Capacities versus address windows, shared GPU VRAM, packed texels, GTE registers versus addressed GEO jobs and ROM/private sample-RAM source binding versus uploads are explicit. Two independently source-audited selected-route schematics, not electrical wiring or observed screenshots.

visibility.resolution: Input one-shot request/sequence, delayed reset, retained PCRTC presentation configuration, GTE results/GEO jobs and separate APU FIFO delivery, whole-batch RAM commit and playback boundaries are explicit within orientation scope.

timing.resolution: 33,868,800 Hz system cycle-accounting timebase; qualified DMA span/block charges; IMGDEC 2 cycles/output word; PCRTC 13,500,000 Hz calculation reference and programmable timing; GEO 16,384,000 outer-record service units/s; APU 44,100 stereo frames/s and 1,058,400 32-bit words/s sample-memory DMA service. No independent core/bus MHz, CPU wait states or sustained end-to-end bandwidth inferred.

interrupts.resolution: IRQ pending/ACK/MASK/CPU-enable and coalescing are summarized; CPU is the consumer, faults are separate. Owning IRQ/SYSTEM/unit chapters define complete delivery and source protocols.

faults.resolution: Synchronous exceptions and SYSTEM captured fault words are distinguished from maskable IRQ. Detailed fault/access/privilege contracts stay in canonical CPU/Memory/IRQ/SYSTEM/unit references rather than being invented by the overview.

reset.resolution: Pending IRQ/mask reset and deferred SYSTEM reset request are explicit; capture is not reset and cartridge entry does not release firmware VRAM. Complete per-unit reset protocols remain in their references.

programming.resolution: Fresh public-only full-overview reader passes after two concrete corrections: shared admitted DMA block versus outstanding channels, and omission of an internal-only capture timestamp. Orientation links and resource/route distinctions accepted; no new program, runtime proof or whole-SDK/whole-console acceptance is claimed.
